facts.P1_fx_receipts: Bring earnings home within 180 days; you don't have to convert them to rupees.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: open a Personal Foreign Currency Account (PFCA).
facts.P3_local_gateways: PayHere accepts freelancers without business registration; USD payouts need a registered business.
facts.L1_registration: Not needed under your own name; register a trade name within 14 days.
facts.L2_tax_id: Everyone 18 or older needs a TIN; register online with your NIC.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Maximum 15% tax on foreign-currency earnings sent home through a bank.
facts.L4_vat_gst: VAT is 18%, but only above LKR 60 million a year.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data protection rules start applying on 1 January 2027.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online-specific rules; general consumer and e-contract laws apply.
facts.L7_incentives: 15% tax cap on service exports, and no VAT below LKR 60 million.

watch_out.text: Bring foreign earnings home within 180 days of doing the work.
The 15% tax cap applies only if paid in foreign currency through a bank.
PayPal receiving works only with a Sampath or Commercial Bank account.
